evidence.text: Infer vacuum-energy scaling from BPS wall tensions: λ = e^(K/2)W, T = Δλ, and Λ ∼ −|λ|². At large flux, T supplies dλ/dn; gravitational junction conditions motivate this strategy.

sources.title: Weak gravity versus scale separation

evidence.text: For N=8, vanishing spin-1/2 supersymmetry variations sets A₂=0. E7(7)/SU(8) identities then relate the gravitino mass to gauge charges. Moving to a purely electric frame and normalizing the vectors yields the corresponding charge bound. Partial-breaking examples use consistency of truncated supersymmetry transformations and N=2 multiplet arrangements.

sources.title: Holography and the KKLT scenario

evidence.text: Uses BPS domain-wall gradient flow for |Z|=exp(K/2)|W|, including nonperturbative terms, to motivate an IR worldvolume CFT. AdS3/CFT2 and cUV≥cIR then translate a UV degree bound into an AdS-radius bound.

sources.title: Pure supersymmetric AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: The argument combines holographic stress-tensor/current two-point-function scaling, the large-radius flat-space limit, and matching to maximal ungauged supergravity. Vanishing coupling abelianizes the nonabelian field strengths.

sources.title: KKLT compactifications ex nihilo

evidence.text: Replace all compactification fluxes across a domain wall by zero, impose tadpole cancellation, and include the lower-dimensional branes required on the fluxless side. Their endpoints form spikes on the wall.

sources.title: On scale-separated supersymmetric $\hbox {AdS}_2$ flux vacua

evidence.text: The supergravity construction dualizes a specific combination involving the dilaton multiplet's auxiliary scalar into H2=dB1, then couples a κ-symmetric superparticle. Distributional field equations and Killing-spinor equations determine static wall solutions and preserved supersymmetry.
